# Tabvergence

> Tabvergence is a Chrome extension that gathers every open tab from the site you're on, across all windows, into one tidy window. No account, no ads, no tracking, and nothing leaves your browser.

- [Home](https://tabvergence.com/): what it is
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/tabvergence/bmgbmdhngkfeklbcmkpigkflabjfnmgb): install the extension
- [How it works and FAQ](https://tabvergence.com/about.html): usage, settings and common questions
- [Privacy policy](https://tabvergence.com/privacy.html): no data is collected, sent or shared
